headline: Japanese Net Foreign Bond Sales Reach Record ¥5.1 Trillion Year-to-Date
summary: Japanese institutional investors sold a net 5.1 trillion yen in foreign debt securities this year, marking their largest net sales of overseas bonds for the period since 2022.
why: Japanese capital flows are a crucial driver of global bond markets due to Japan's substantial foreign investment portfolio.

impacts.name: US 10-year Treasury yield
impacts.why: Heavy Japanese net liquidation of overseas debt reduces demand for foreign bonds.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Record net debt sales by Japanese investors reduced demand in international bond markets.
